name: Park Agent Task
description: Use only for an assigned task shown in the current task context. Keep the in-scope task open and have it brought back to you after a delay, when you cannot finish it now: you are waiting for something, or you have asked the requester a question. The requester sees the reason. New input for the task brings it back sooner, and if the task is completed, failed or cancelled first the revisit does nothing. Not terminal: reply as usual afterwards, and that reply goes to the conversation, not to the task. The agent and task are determined from the current request context — no id is passed. Without a task in scope the call fails.

delay.description: How long to wait before the task is brought back, in milliseconds.

reason.description: Why the task is parked, shown to the requester while it waits.

wakeTime.description: When the task is brought back, in milliseconds on the venue's clock.
